name: R. H. Montgomery
bio: R. H. (Bob) Montgomery was a Belfield man who visited Medora in February 1884 with good reports of his town and was sick that March. The Belfield columns of 1884 noted the redecoration of his place and a new addition to it, and his return from the east in August.

moments.label: Returned to Belfield from the east
